name: Anari
source:
Peerless with the bow, she was once a hired mercenary, renowned for her skills. She has a strong prejudice against monsters, and can be extremely ruthless.

Uses she/her pronouns.
Likes: Fine black tea and hunting game
Dislikes: Giving up and admitting defeat
